newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to announce April-June GDP data on Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: Japan to announce April-June GDP data on Sept 13.

text.p: Japan will announce its gross domestic product (GDP) data for the April-June quarter on September 13 at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT), the government's Economic Planning Agency said on Wednesday.
Japan's GDP, the nation's total output of goods and services minus net income from overseas output, in January-March grew 3.0 percent from the previous quarter, or an annualised 12.7 percent.

Economists polled by Reuters showed that GDP, a key gauge of the economy's health, would show a quarter-on-quarter fall of between 0.3 and 1.8 percent in the April to June period, mainly due to a drop in consumer spending.
The economists' prediction would translate to a fall of between 1.0 percent and 6.6 percent on an annualised basis.
